text: Photography is an art form that uses cameras to record images through the creation of light and shadow on film or a digital sensor. The camera’s shutter is a crucial component that controls how long light is allowed to fall on the sensor, determining the exposure of the image. A fast shutter speed can freeze motion, while a slow shutter can capture motion. Beyond shutter, photographers often adjust the aperture to control the amount of light entering the lens, influencing depth of field and overall composition. As camera technology advances, so too do the features that enhance these foundational aspects of photography, allowing photographers to craft beautiful images.
